name: Land League Badge
desc: A tin badge on a green ribbon, struck for the community that bought its own hill. The back is stamped with the date of the ballot and a thistle that has seen better days.
msg: {name}'s Land League Badge turned the cold aside!

name: Ceilidh Shortbread
desc: Flour, butter and sugar in the old 3-2-1 sum, baked in the Braes Hall oven for the opening night. Restores 120 HP and leaves crumbs in the bag for weeks.
